result.rationale: The diff adds `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` in group.hbs; group_member.hbs then uses `{{#unless automatic}}` around the remove link. In the item view the context is the member (Discourse.User), which has no `automatic` property, so it's undefined and the remove link renders even for automatic groups, producing 422s on click. The parent template does guard with `{{#unless automatic}}` for the add-members section, but not for the members list, confirming the intent wasn't carried into the item view.
